## [3.102.0] - 2026-10-29

### Features

- select workflow and authenticate deposit employee
- update cash deposit localization and remove reverse functionality
- add cash deposit localization and central cash box support
- add cash deposits feature with localization and service integration

### Bug Fixes

- preserve restored route while toggle loads
- count tier sequences toward transaction limit
- repeat tier sequence within transaction limit

### Other Changes

- AION-677: Respect effective preset when styling quick buttons
- AION-677: Align quick button styling across retail presets
- align tier limit regression with sequence semantics
- update cash deposits backend with CI fix
